import polars as pl
import re
from datetime import datetime
import math


def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    # Helper to clean placeholder strings into nulls
    def clean_str(col_name: str) -> pl.Expr:
        s = pl.col(col_name).str.strip_chars()
        return pl.when(s.is_in(["", "N/A", "n/a", "-", "null", "NULL"])) \
            .then(None) \
            .otherwise(s)

    # Convert columns according to target specification
    return raw.select(
        order_id=clean_str("Order").str.to_uppercase(),
        line_no=clean_str("Line #").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False),
        sold_at=(
            clean_str("Date") + " " + clean_str("Time")
        ).str.to_datetime(
            format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
            time_unit="us",
            strict=False
        ),
        store=clean_str("@sheet").str.to_uppercase(),
        sku=clean_str("SKU").str.to_uppercase(),
        qty=clean_str("Qty").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False),
        unit_price=clean_str("Unit Price").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).round(2),
        discount=clean_str("Discount").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).round(2),
        line_total=clean_str("Total").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).round(2)
    )
